text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Antonio Champalimaud's group is studying the possibility of merging Banco Totta & Acores and Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor, a source close to the process tells the paper.
- An opinion poll says Socialist Party would win a clear majority if early elections were held. Popularity of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres rising, according to the poll.
- Demand for shares in the privatisation of Cimpor has reached 53 percent of total number of shares available as the pre-registration period continues.
